context_requirements: Expression of the specific calcium channel or calcium-signaling pathway targeted by the drug
Dependence on calcium-dependent signaling for survival or proliferation
Presence of the drug's direct protein target (not specified for this class)
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines at 10 micromolar
Enrichment of calcium-signaling or apoptosis gene sets at 24 h

evidence.supports: The calcium channel modulator bepridil inhibits NOTCH1 signaling and induces apoptosis in chronic lymphocytic leukemia cells, indicating that some calcium channel modulators can have transcriptional consequences in specific hematopoietic contexts.

Orai1-mediated calcium mobilization regulates proliferation, migration, and apoptosis in epithelial ovarian cancer cells, showing that calcium channel modulation can affect transcriptional programs in some cancer cell lines.

Orai1/CRACM1 calcium channel activity is required for steroid-induced apoptosis in an insect cell line, demonstrating context-dependent transcriptional and apoptotic responses to calcium channel modulation.
